reading.body:
Four projects make up this collection with a combined 332,165 GitHub stars, led by AutoGPT at 187,065, more than twice the combined stars of the other three projects tracked here.

OpenHands follows at 85,887 stars, and gpt-engineer holds 55,111 stars despite being marked archived, meaning its codebase is no longer actively maintained even though its star count remains the third highest in the category. langroid trails far behind at 4,102 stars. That an archived project still outranks an actively maintained one, langroid, by a wide margin shows star count in this category reflects historical adoption more than current development activity.

Licensing splits narrowly, with three of the four projects, OpenHands, gpt-engineer, and langroid, released under MIT, while AutoGPT alone uses a custom licence, a 3-to-1 split toward the permissive MIT terms that more closely resembles the coding and browser agents category elsewhere in this collection than the single-licence agent memory category.
